plants.name: Cretan brake fern
plants.tip: Never let the rootball dry out. A frond that crisps once will not green up again.
plants.colour: Mid-green, narrow ribbon-like leaflets on thin black stalks

plants.name: Pteris cretica 'Albolineata'
plants.tip: The white band narrows in a dim corner. Bright indirect light keeps it broad.
plants.colour: Grey-green with a broad white band down the centre of each leaflet

plants.name: Pteris cretica 'Mayii'
plants.tip: Cut spent fronds right back at the base so the crested tips stay the shape you see.
plants.colour: White-banded pale green leaflets ending in frilled, crested tips

plants.name: Pteris cretica 'Parkeri'
plants.tip: Broad fronds lose water fast. In summer check the compost twice a week, not weekly.
plants.colour: Glossy deep green, broad leaflets with a slightly wavy edge

plants.name: Pteris cretica 'Roweri'
plants.tip: Compact enough for a terrarium, but it needs moving air or the crown rots.
plants.colour: Deep green, frilled leaflets on a low, dense clump

plants.name: Pteris cretica 'Wimsettii'
plants.tip: The uneven, forked fronds are the cultivar, not damage. Remove only fully brown ones.
plants.colour: Plain green, deeply and irregularly cut with forked tips

plants.name: Pteris cretica 'Rivertoniana'
plants.tip: Lacy fronds scorch in one afternoon of direct sun. Keep it off a south-facing sill.
plants.colour: Mid-green with narrow, irregularly lobed finger-like leaflets

plants.name: Pteris cretica 'Cristata'
plants.tip: Crested tips hold water and rot. Water the compost and leave the fronds dry.
plants.colour: Plain green leaflets ending in fine crested tufts

plants.name: Pteris cretica 'Alexandrae'
plants.tip: Both the white centre and the crests fade in low light. Give it a bright north window.
plants.colour: White-centred leaflets with broad, ruffled crested tips

plants.name: Pteris cretica 'Childsii'
plants.tip: The frilled edge crisps first when air is dry. Stand the pot on wet gravel.
plants.colour: Light green, broad leaflets frilled along the whole edge

plants.name: Pteris cretica 'Distinction'
plants.tip: Smaller than the plain species, so it dries out sooner in a small pot. Water little and often.
plants.colour: Mid-green, deeply lobed leaflets that branch at the tips

plants.name: Pteris cretica 'Ping Wu'
plants.tip: A dwarf with fine fronds, and it drowns in a large pot. Keep it slightly potbound.
plants.colour: Narrow, almost grass-like green fronds on a low clump

plants.name: Pteris cretica 'Marianna'
plants.tip: Hardy outdoors in mild gardens. Indoors it wants a cool room rather than a warm one.
plants.colour: Plain mid-green ribbon fronds on wiry dark stalks

plants.name: Pteris cretica var. nervosa
plants.tip: Leathery enough to take cooler rooms, but it still dies if the compost dries through.
plants.colour: Mid-green, leathery ribbon leaflets with a paler midrib

plants.name: Pteris cretica var. laeta
plants.tip: Give it room. The fronds spread wider than the plant stands tall.
plants.colour: Broad mid-green leaflets with a wavy margin

plants.name: Pteris cretica var. laeta 'Western Hills'
plants.tip: It dies back in a cold winter and returns in spring. Do not throw out a bare crown.
plants.colour: Fresh green, broad wavy leaflets on a wide, deciduous clump

plants.name: Pteris ensiformis
plants.tip: The taller, narrower fertile fronds are normal. Cut them off for a low, even plant.
plants.colour: Slim dark green leaflets, the fertile fronds taller and narrower

plants.name: Pteris ensiformis 'Victoriae'
plants.tip: The silver areas carry no chlorophyll, so it grows slowly. Feed weakly and be patient.
plants.colour: Dark green with a white central line and wavy margins

plants.name: Pteris ensiformis 'Evergemiensis'
plants.tip: Nearly white fronds burn fast in direct sun. Bright shade, and never a hot windowsill.
plants.colour: Broad creamy-white centres inside a narrow dark green margin

plants.name: Pteris multifida
plants.tip: The toughest brake, and it tolerates the dry room air that kills the Cretan forms.
plants.colour: Thin, skeletal green fingers on wiry green stalks

plants.name: Pteris multifida 'Ouvrardii'
plants.tip: The arching fronds snap if the plant is crowded. Give it space on all sides.
plants.colour: Arching green fronds with wavy-edged narrow leaflets

plants.name: Pteris multifida 'Jade Waterfall'
plants.tip: Small enough to dry out in a day on a warm sill. A saucer of damp gravel helps.
plants.colour: Small jade-green cascading fronds on a low evergreen clump

plants.name: Pteris multifida 'Korean Petticoat'
plants.tip: Frilled tips brown at the edges in dry air before anything else shows.
plants.colour: Green skeletal fronds ending in frilled, petticoat crests

plants.name: Pteris vittata
plants.tip: A limestone cliff fern, so sharp drainage and hard tap water both suit it.
plants.colour: Long ladder-like pale green fronds from a scaly base

plants.name: Pteris vittata 'Benzilan'
plants.tip: Deciduous in a cold winter. Cut the old fronds down in late winter and wait.
plants.colour: Long pale green ladder fronds on a wide, deciduous clump

plants.name: Pteris vittata 'Taoyuan'
plants.tip: It wants full light and gritty compost. Rich, wet soil rots the crown.
plants.colour: Upright pale green ladder fronds on stiff stalks

plants.name: Pteris argyraea
plants.tip: The silver band is brightest on new fronds, so keep it fed and growing through summer.
plants.colour: Large green fronds with a broad silver-white band along each leaflet

plants.name: Pteris quadriaurita
plants.tip: A big, fast tropical fern. Warmth and steady moisture matter more than light does.
plants.colour: Large triangular green fronds on reddish stalks

plants.name: Pteris aspericaulis 'Tricolor'
plants.tip: Only the new fronds carry the red. Warmth and constant moisture keep them coming.
plants.colour: New fronds flushed red over a silver band, ageing to green

plants.name: Pteris tremula
plants.tip: It grows fast and goes top-heavy. Pot it on each spring or it dries between waterings.
plants.colour: Pale green, finely divided fronds on tall wiry stalks

plants.name: Pteris umbrosa
plants.tip: A gully-floor fern from deep shade. Direct sun bleaches the fronds within days.
plants.colour: Dark green, coarse leaflets on an upright spreading clump

plants.name: Pteris longifolia
plants.tip: It grows in walls and cracks, so gritty, thin compost suits it better than rich.
plants.colour: Long fronds with forty or more narrow, close-set leaflets

plants.name: Pteris wallichiana
plants.tip: It runs on thick rhizomes, so a wide shallow pot beats a deep one.
plants.colour: Large mid-green fronds branching into three broad arms

plants.name: Pteris wallichiana 'Hualien Giant'
plants.tip: Allow a metre of space before planting. The clump gets far wider than it first looks.
plants.colour: Very large mid-green fronds on a spreading, rhizomatous clump

plants.name: Pteris nipponica
plants.tip: The rhizome creeps at the surface. Top-dress around it rather than burying the crown.
plants.colour: Green pinnate fronds with a central creamy-white stripe

plants.name: Pteris oshimensis
plants.tip: Wider than it is tall, so set it where the arching fronds are not brushed past.
plants.colour: Dark green arching fronds on a low, broad clump

plants.name: Pteris dentata
plants.tip: Tall and thin-textured, so it wilts in a draught from a door or a heater.
plants.colour: Pale green, finely toothed leaflets on tall slender stalks

plants.name: Pteris fauriei
plants.tip: Cold-tolerant but not drought-tolerant. Kept damp it will take an unheated room.
plants.colour: Dark green triangular fronds on dark wiry stalks

plants.name: Pteris semipinnata
plants.tip: The one-sided fronds are normal. Keep humidity up or the fine teeth brown off.
plants.colour: Green fronds with comb-like leaflets cut away on one side
